title: Assembly Line
reference: repeat 2 { F1 turn_right } F1 turn_left F1 def F1 { forward jump activate }
hints: Every platform is the same: one step, a hop up or down, then the switch. Only the turns change.
F1 does step, hop, switch. The first two turns are both right, so a loop can do them.
repeat 2 { F1 turn_right } F1 turn_left F1 def F1 { forward jump activate }

story.outro: PATCH: "Assembly line's humming. VANTA won't like that."
